responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s global string-interning service for symbol names. It defines the Name key type and operations to create or look up stable keys from character data, recover text from keys, test key existence or case-insensitive equality, and obtain C-string views, providing the canonical name representation shared by the symbol tables, AST nodes, diagnostics, and code generator.
same_name_distinction: This is the public definition module for the name interning service, declaring the Name type, NulName constant, and exported lookup/conversion procedures. Unlike nameKey.mod, it does not implement the binary-tree storage, key index, or string allocation logic.
